title: Integration Testing for User CRUD
description: Build a complete integration test suite for a user CRUD API, testing create, read, update, and delete operations with verification.

steps.title: List users endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /users endpoint that returns a list of users with status 200.
hints: Return an array of user objects
Start with an empty array if no users exist

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

users = []

@app.get('/users')
def list_users():
    return users

steps.title: Create and retrieve a user
steps.description: Add POST /users to create a user (201) and GET /users/:id to retrieve it (200).
hints: POST /users accepts name and email, returns 201 with the created user
GET /users/:id returns a single user by id
Verify the created user can be retrieved by GET /users/:id

steps.title: Update a user
steps.description: Add PUT /users/:id to update a user and return 200, then verify with GET.
hints: Accept name and email in the request body to update
Find the user by id and update fields
Return 200 with the updated user, verify via GET

steps.title: Delete a user and verify
steps.description: Add DELETE /users/:id that returns 200, then verify with GET that user is gone (404).
hints: Remove the user from the array by id
